The second part of the first volume of Jhā's translation of Manu with Medhātithi's commentary: the sacraments of childhood, the student's life and the rules of Vedic study.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Manu-smrti: Laws Of Mnau With The Bhasya Of Medhatithi Vol.1; Pt.2 · Jha, Ganga Natha · 1921, 296 scanned pages. Published 1921; Ganganatha Jha died 1941; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
